title: retryDeadTasks request
description: POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}/dead-tasks:retry - request. Moves FAILED tasks of the job back to PENDING (AP-F8).
$comment: Source: DISENO S4 (b), (d) StartFanOutUseCase/CancelFanOutUseCase/FanOutStatusQuery, (e) operator APIs (RF-121), AP-F6, AP-F7; PRD RF-121, RF-022; US-08.2.1; DISENO 4.4 CMD-06 RetryFanOutTasks.v1; 4.5 (g); 7.4 runbook; RF-107, RF-085; US-08.2.2. Audience: OPERATOR (operator console / role-restricted). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); job view is OPERATIONAL (counters, no engagement ids). Idempotency: Idempotency-Key required and used as requestId (fanout_job.lastRetryRequestId); runs the same use case as RetryFanOutTasks.v1 and sends no message (DEC-24). Pagination: n/a.

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120). idempotency-key is required on every write (DISENO 3.8.5, DEC-35).

body.description: Retry request (same fields as RetryFanOutTasks.v1 except requestId, which is the Idempotency-Key).

failureReasons.description: Which FAILED tasks to retry, by failureReason; absent = all FAILED tasks.

max.description: Maximum number of tasks to move FAILED -> PENDING.
